figurative_meaning_en: To curtail or diminish one's power or capabilities
example_sentences_in_bangla: সরকার তার বিরোধীদের ডানা কেটে দিয়েছে।
পরিবারের সদস্যরা ছেলের ডানা কাটতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: The government has clipped the wings of its opponents.
The family doesn't want to clip the boy's wings.
note: This idiom draws from the imagery of birds losing flight ability, symbolizing restricted mobility or influence in Bengali expressive language.
